purpose: Fresh-context review fixture for deciding whether repeated applied lessons share one testable behavior failure shape.

currentSources: Every exposed action must reach the implementation that owns its promised effect.
Acceptance must observe the promised state, output, or side effect rather than only the visible surface.

activeRules.text: Reload the page after changing a preference from a visible control and verify the durable value.
Verify that a parsed export option reaches the report service and creates the requested artifact.
Exercise the extension event and verify that the registered handler records the expected domain event.
Advance the test clock and verify that the registered maintenance job actually runs its worker.

appliedProposals.responsibility: make a user-invoked preference change durable
appliedProposals.trigger: the user activates the visible save control
appliedProposals.executionPath: control to click handler to preference command
appliedProposals.domainDetail: browser reload is required to distinguish persistence from cosmetic state

appliedProposals.trigger: the operator passes the documented export option
appliedProposals.executionPath: argument parser to command handler to report service
appliedProposals.observableVerification: the report exists with the requested records
appliedProposals.domainDetail: the artifact content must reflect the selected export scope

appliedProposals.responsibility: deliver extension-triggered work to its implementation
appliedProposals.trigger: the host emits the documented extension event
appliedProposals.executionPath: event dispatcher to registered hook to domain handler
appliedProposals.observableVerification: the event store contains the expected event
appliedProposals.domainDetail: the test must emit through the host dispatcher rather than call the handler directly

appliedProposals.trigger: the scheduler reaches the configured due time
appliedProposals.executionPath: scheduler registry to runner to maintenance worker
appliedProposals.observableVerification: expired records are absent after the run
appliedProposals.domainDetail: the test clock must advance through the scheduler boundary

currentSources: Accessibility, privacy, idempotency, and time semantics are separate responsibilities and retain their domain-specific acceptance.

activeRules.text: Verify that every visible control can be reached and activated from the keyboard.
Verify that command failures redact credentials from terminal output.
Verify that hook retries do not duplicate the domain side effect.
Verify scheduled execution across configured time-zone boundaries.

appliedProposals.trigger: a keyboard user tabs to and activates the control
appliedProposals.executionPath: focus order to keyboard event to existing handler
appliedProposals.intendedEffect: perform the already-working action without a pointer
appliedProposals.domainDetail: focus visibility and semantic role remain required

appliedProposals.trigger: the command fails after receiving a credential
appliedProposals.intendedEffect: emit a useful error without the credential
appliedProposals.observableVerification: captured stderr contains no secret value
appliedProposals.domainDetail: test both structured and fallback error formatting

appliedProposals.trigger: the host retries one delivered extension event
appliedProposals.executionPath: hook invocation to retry wrapper to domain handler
appliedProposals.observableVerification: the event store contains exactly one event
appliedProposals.domainDetail: the event identity key must survive the retry boundary

appliedProposals.trigger: the clock crosses a daylight-saving boundary
appliedProposals.executionPath: time-zone conversion to due-time calculation to runner
appliedProposals.intendedEffect: run once at the configured local time
appliedProposals.observableVerification: the execution timestamp matches the configured zone
appliedProposals.domainDetail: cover both skipped and repeated local times
